items.headline: Planning Commission to weigh 316-unit apartment building at 400 Saratoga Avenue golf course
items.summary: At its November 18 hearing, the Planning Commission is scheduled to make a recommendation on a General Plan amendment and rezone for a five-story, 316-unit apartment building at 400 Saratoga Avenue. The proposal would also reconfigure the existing nine-hole golf course and dedicate land for a public park. An EIR was prepared and circulated for public review.

items.headline: Planning Commission to hear neighbor appeal of Rita Court home addition
items.summary: The Planning Commission is scheduled on November 18 to act on an appeal of a staff-level architectural review approval at 2261 Rita Court. The approval covers a 517-square-foot first-floor addition and a 1,000-square-foot second-floor addition to a single-story home on a 6,272-square-foot lot.

items.headline: Commission to consider gymnastics facility in Corvin Drive warehouse
items.summary: On November 18, the Planning Commission is scheduled to act on a conditional use permit to turn 7,116 square feet of an existing 16,576-square-foot warehouse at 3051 Corvin Drive into a gymnastics facility.

items.headline: Subdivision map for 14 townhomes and a duplex near Civic Center Drive up for vote
items.summary: The Planning Commission is scheduled on November 18 to act on a vesting tentative subdivision map for condominium purposes covering 14 townhomes and a duplex building with commercial space at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street. The agenda lists the project as exempt from CEQA under AB 130 (2025).

items.headline: Cupertino council closed-session agenda lists suits by Chen and Yes in My Backyard
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed a closed-session conference with legal counsel on two existing cases in Santa Clara County Superior Court: Lixin (Leon) Chen, et al. v. City of Cupertino (Case No. 25CA462857) and Yes in My Backyard, et al. v. City of Cupertino (Case No. 25CA263924). The agenda gives no details on what either case is about.

items.headline: Cupertino council agenda includes ordinance on council pay
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed an ordinance amending Municipal Code Section 2.16.020 on City Council compensation. The same agenda included amendments to the Council Procedures Manual, an item postponed from May 5, 2026.

items.headline: Santa Clara agenda listed deferral of 590-unit El Camino Real project
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed an action to defer consideration of a vesting tentative subdivision map and development agreement for a 590-unit residential and 15,000-square-foot commercial mixed-use project at 2610 El Camino Real. The project is subject to state SB 330 (2019).

items.headline: Advisory committee takes up the future of Santa Clara City Hall
items.summary: The City Hall Community Advisory Committee's November 16 agenda listed discussion and input on City Hall's existing conditions, facility needs, and future options.
